To rerun a failed or flaky build on a PR, comment `retest this please` on the PR; Jenkins picks it up within a minute.","criticality":0.5,"epistemic":"fact","id":"01a106ba-6ab6-7d11-b13f-c19b205bf125","invalidated_at":"2026-10-04T11:44:06.190708966Z","logical":["ci"],"physical":["/"],"provenance":"human","status":"challenged","summary":"Rerunning CI builds","superseded_by":"01a106ba-76da-7880-b8f1-276382a562ad","tags":["ci","workflow"],"type":"convention","visibility":"shared"}}

CI runs on Buildkite now. Since 2026-08-12 it has been there; Jenkins was shut down. To rerun the flaky build, do either of these:

- **In the Buildkite web UI:** open the failed build from the PR's check link and press **Retry** on the failed job. This reruns only that job, not the whole pipeline.
- **From the command line:** run `bk build retry <build-number>`, using the build number shown in the PR check.

Commenting `retest this please` on the PR no longer does anything. That only worked with Jenkins.

This comes from the team's shared notes. The repo has no CI config I could check it against. Those notes also had an older entry that still gave the Jenkins instructions, so I flagged it as superseded by the Buildkite one.

If the same test keeps failing, I can help track down why it's flaky.
